{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

df['biomarker_change'] = df['biomarker_final'] - df['biomarker_baseline']

# Remove rows with sentinel values (-999.0) in baseline or final
valid_df = df[(df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0) & (df['biomarker_final'] != -999.0)]

# Check for confounding: severity is not balanced across arms
# control: 71.2% mild, 23.3% moderate, 5.5% severe
# treatment: 21.1% mild, 37.6% moderate, 41.2% severe

# Compute biomarker change by arm in valid data
change_by_arm = valid_df.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].describe()
mean_change_control = change_by_arm.loc['control', 'mean']
mean_change_treatment = change_by_arm.loc['treatment', 'mean']
mean_diff = mean_change_treatment - mean_change_control

# Perform stratified analysis by severity
print("Biomarker change by arm and severity:")
stratified = valid_df.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['biomarker_change'].mean().round(2)
print(stratified)

# Compute the difference in mean biomarker change within each severity stratum
print("\nMean difference (treatment - control) by severity:")
diff_by_severity = stratified['treatment'] - stratified['control']
print(diff_by_severity)

# Compute overall mean biomarker change difference
print(f"\nOverall mean difference (treatment - control): {mean_diff:.2f}")"}
